messages:
Alex: quick one — i'm prepping a tiny 'mini-deploy' quickstart for the new onboarding flow, aiming for a 3-step guide that shows auth, a single endpoint call, and one deployment command. want to sync on minimal snippets and a follow-up PR.
Brianna: nice. can we make the auth section use the SDK cookie-free example? smaller than the full server flow.
Chris: +1 for cookie-free. Also suggest we include a one-liner for env var export and a curl fallback.
Alex: example plan — 1) set REDWOOD_API_KEY env 2) run `npm run start` 3) call curl/SDK. draft snippet attached in PR once i have tests.
Jordan: quick question — are we changing any param names in the SDK? need to avoid breaking existing starter apps.
Brianna: no breaking changes planned. SDK team kept aliases for v3 compatibility.
Chris: PR checklist: snippet lint, small smoke test, update docs index link, add migration note to migration.md (short para).
Alex: cool. i'll open a draft PR in a bit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/462 (WIP)
Brianna: reading the draft — two nits: (1) under auth show `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` (2) the curl example should use `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` for parity.
Alex: updated the snippet, pushed. also added a tiny JS fetch example for browsers (uses fetch with Authorization header).
Jordan: can we keep the browser example as optional? some teams prefer server-first. maybe collapse under a "Browser (optional)" heading.
Chris: agree, mark it optional. Also add a short note: "If you embed keys client-side, rotate keys with strict scopes" — link to key-safety page.
Alex: added the optional heading and rotation note, plus a link to https://docs.redwood.ai/security/key-rotation
doc-bot: CI: doc linter passed. link-checker found one broken anchor in /getting-started/index.md -> fixed in branch.
Brianna: thanks. small ask: can we include a 1-line command to run the local model emulator? e.g., `redwood local start` so new devs can try without onboarding credits.
Alex: added `redwood local start` under prerequisites. also updated quickstart TOC to include "Mini deploy" entry.
Jordan: reviewers? I can take first pass tomorrow AM.
Chris: i'll do final QA after Jordan. target merge by EOD Thursday if no major issues.
Alex: perfect — i'll post a short release note in #announcements when merged. thanks all :tada:
